author: cl-handfix
body: [opus 5.5] Reopened: an independent review of 340b8d94 found a blocking bug (a live agent refused as undeliverable whenever an archive entry starts with its name) and four more (older senders never retry "undeliverable"; a handover leaves a pinned coordinator process so the new coordinator cannot send; watch-agents records the flag notice before delivery and sends it to the retired coordinator; a standing warning made watch-agents not-OK forever). Fixed forward on main; closes again with the fix.
